subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those announce turns always tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch is coherent and tested, but it changes persisted session recovery semantics and an internal tool-execution boundary that should be explicitly accepted by an owner before merge.

options.title: Accept This Recovery Model
options.body: Merge after `check-lint` is green, treating aborted announce delivery turns as non-human recovery state and always tool-free.

options.title: Change The Terminal State
options.body: Ask the contributor to use a more explicit non-running state or metadata shape if `killed` should not represent an aborted delivery-only announce turn.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want one generalized delivery recovery model instead of an announce-specific persisted marker.

recommendation.title: Accept This Recovery Model
recommendation.body: Merge after `check-lint` is green, treating aborted announce delivery turns as non-human recovery state and always tool-free.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart recovery lifecycle seam and Codex/internal-turn work make this owner the strongest match for the session-state and tool-boundary decision.
